minor.issue: Auto-numbering uses count_documents({}) (same race-prone pattern as Phase 1-4). Acceptable for v1; mention in known-limitations.

When a line is rejected mid-iteration due to insufficient-stock 400, lines already processed (positive deltas + inserted ledger rows) are NOT rolled back. Recommend a single MongoDB transaction or pre-validate all negative-diff lines BEFORE any $inc/insert. Likelihood low (race-protected positive deltas only post AFTER negative validations succeed) but technically possible if 2 admins approve concurrently.

Sequential awaits (~14 count_documents + 3 cursor iterations + 1 aggregation). For very large DBs latency will grow; could be parallelised via asyncio.gather. Current response under 1s on test DB, so not urgent.
Loads all inventory rows in memory (to_list(10000)); no pagination. Fine for v1 but consider streaming or pagination if >10k items.

critical_code_review_comments: inventory_phase5_router.py L221-247 (approve_stock_count): the per-line loop is NOT atomic. If one negative-diff line hits the 400 insufficient-stock path AFTER previous lines have already done $inc + inserted txn rows, the DB is left half-applied. For multi-line variance approvals this can cause silent partial state. Either run all negative-diff debits inside a Mongo session transaction, or pre-scan all lines to validate qty sufficiency before mutation.
L187: `no = f'SC-{...}-{count_documents}'.zfill(5)` race-prone — two concurrent POSTs may receive the same count and emit identical count_no.

L313-316 (pending_ppe_expiry): the query filters expiry_date <= today+30d but does NOT exclude already-expired dates, so this tile counts both upcoming-30d AND historically expired rows. Consider an explicit `$gte: today` lower bound. Same tile is labelled 'PPE Expiring (30d)' — currently semantically slightly off.

L291: rate fallback chain in dashboard is `rate || average_rate || last_purchase_rate` whereas valuation endpoint prefers `average_rate || last_purchase_rate || rate`. The two endpoints can therefore disagree on `total_stock_value` for the same items. Recommend pulling rate-selection into a helper used by both endpoints.
L48 valuation `find(q, {_id: 0}).sort('name', 1).to_list(10000)` — magic 10000 cap; no pagination. Same applies to dashboard items load. Fine for v1 but flag for scale.

Phase5Views.jsx L116 — `Promise.all([api.get('/inv5/stock-counts'), api.get('/inventory')])`. If `/inventory` returns >10k items the picker becomes painfully slow. Consider a typeahead/search picker for production.
Phase5Views.jsx StockCountView submit() silently coerces NaN qty to 0; would be friendlier to surface 'enter a number' inline error.
